description:
`GldpcDecoder::decode_soft` in `crates/gf2-coding/src/gldpc/mod.rs:791` is reported to return hard decisions of its input without running the decoder.

## Background

Reported by the comment sweep of the GLDPC module.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A test reproduces the reported behavior at the cited location, or a record shows the report does not hold and the issue is rejected with that evidence.
- [hard] REQ-02: `decode_soft` decodes, or the method is removed from the public surface; the shared decoder conformance suite covers it.
title: GldpcDecoder::decode_soft returns hard decisions without decoding
